structured_output.title: Alert your crew by text without a developer
structured_output.hook: Your crew is out on site and nobody reads email. Here is how to turn the alerts you already send into texts, with no developer.

script.text: Your crew is out on site, and the alert sits in an inbox.
TextBolt sends text alerts from email, so the tools you already use can text your crew.
No developer is required to set it up.
Send a test alert and watch it land on your phone in seconds.
Replies come back to the inbox that sent the alert.
